title: ASRock X670E Pro RS Motherboard $218.49 ($18 off with PayPal) @ YSI Motherboard Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: ASRock X670E Pro RS Motherboard $218.49 ($18 off with PayPal) @ YSI Motherboard Store AliExpress

[xxJAGUARxx] Asrock sucks! Avoid this brand especially if you going with 9800x3d. I got a nitro b850m recently for a nitro 9060xt build. And an Aorus elite wifi for nvidia build.
[bruhminister] Yeah, wouldn't recommend to anyone on a 9000 series chip or any high end chip for that matter.
My use case with a 7600 is slightly different. Unfortunately Asrock offers better storage flexibility than the other 3.
[cloudie9] The situation with SSD and storage, would end up costing more than the mobo itself…
[vid_ghost] Are Asrock boards still a AM5 CPU russian roulette?
[bruhminister] Yes, no, maybe.
No recent posts on reddit though from a quixk glance.
[xxJAGUARxx] Yah i thought it was an asus brand lol but i was wrong. Lots of arguing with claude and then swapping it for aorus elite 6
[dajackal] Slightly off topic but has anyone bought a Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE V2 off AliExpress? Seems odd I can get something so bulky delivered to my door cheaper than local stock at a computer store.
[bruhminister] At this stage, most on OzB trust aliexpress more than mwave
[appxl] F^%$ Mwave. 3 months and still awaiting a refund from their mistake and they keep closing my ticket saying it was delivered… when it wasn't. And this is AFTER I had to get the NSW Fair Trading involved. Absolute scum bags to deal with.
DO NOT BUY FROM MWAVE. They are trying to cover up how useless they are and even trying to negate negative reviews on Google by giving out free vouchers for a 5 star review.
